key_features: Advanced Bluetooth V5.3: Powered by the AC6965E4 wireless chip for quick pairing, auto-reconnection, and stable signal transmission.
TWS Dual Speaker Pairing: Connect two Blisbond MUSE speakers wirelessly to create an immersive, wider stereo soundstage.
Massive Dual Battery Setup: Dual 1800mAh (3600mAh total) capacity provides up to 22 hours of playback at moderate volume levels.
IPX5 Water-Resistant Build: Rugged exterior resists water splashes, light rain, and dust during outdoor activities.
Versatile Playback Modes: Supports wireless Bluetooth V5.3, TF memory card playback, and 3.5mm AUX wired audio input.
Hands-Free Calling & Mic: Built-in microphone allows clear, hands-free phone calls without disconnecting your device.
Fast USB Type-C Recharging: Replenishes the dual internal batteries in under 3 hours using standard 5V Type-C chargers.
